purpose: Compare hard labels with two temperatures using the same illustrative logits.
alt: Illustrative four-class targets. The hard label assigns cat 100 percent. With logits 4, 2, 0 and minus 2, temperature 1 gives approximately 86.5, 11.7, 1.6 and 0.2 percent. Temperature 3 gives approximately 52.3, 26.8, 13.8 and 7.1 percent. Higher temperature exposes alternatives without changing their ranking.
caption: **Figure 1.** One answer versus a pattern of alternatives. Original toy calculation using Equation (1), not model measurements.
